snapshot.text: Aena, the Spanish airport operator, had a stronger FY2024 as revenue rose by {{revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{revenue@FY2024}} and Fitch upgraded its long-term rating to A.
Net leverage fell by {{net_leverage.change@FY2024}} to {{net_leverage@FY2024}}, with the EBITDA margin widening by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}}.

The point to watch is cash liquidity: cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, taking cash liquidity to revenue down by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}.

credit_metrics.text: EBITDA increased by {{ebitda.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda@FY2024}}, and operating profit rose by {{operating_profit.change@FY2024}} to {{operating_profit@FY2024}} as depreciation, amortisation and impairment grew by {{dda.change@FY2024}} to {{dda@FY2024}}.

Total debt was reduced by {{total_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{total_debt@FY2024}} and net debt by {{net_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{net_debt@FY2024}}, so gross leverage fell by {{gross_leverage.change@FY2024}} to {{gross_leverage@FY2024}}.

Cash generation strengthened: FFO rose by {{ffo.change@FY2024}} to {{ffo@FY2024}}, taking FFO to debt up by {{ffo_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{ffo_to_debt@FY2024}}, and free cash flow rose by {{fcf.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf@FY2024}} as capex fell by {{capex.change@FY2024}} to {{capex@FY2024}}.
Interest coverage eased by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2024}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2024}} as finance costs rose by {{finance_costs.change@FY2024}} to {{finance_costs@FY2024}}.

operating_performance.text: Passengers rose by {{passengers.change@FY2024}} to {{passengers@FY2024}}, although traffic growth slowed by {{traffic_growth.change@FY2024}} to {{traffic_growth@FY2024}}.

Aeronautical revenue per passenger increased by {{aero_revenue_per_passenger.change@FY2024}} to {{aero_revenue_per_passenger@FY2024}}, with the CNMC setting the maximum adjusted annual revenue per passenger for 2025 unchanged versus the prior year.
Capex intensity fell by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2024}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2024}}, and cash from operations rose by {{cfo.change@FY2024}} to {{cfo@FY2024}}.

liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, and cash liquidity to revenue declined by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}.
In FY2023 the group reported liquidity of {{liquidity@FY2023}}, including {{undrawn_facilities@FY2023}} of undrawn committed facilities, and liquidity to revenue of {{liquidity_to_revenue@FY2023}}.
Funding conditions improved during the year, with Fitch raising the long-term rating and Moody's moving the outlook to positive.

peer_positioning.text: Aena has the highest EBITDA margin of the airport peers ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@FY2024}}), at {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}} against a median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@FY2024}}, and leads on interest coverage ({{interest_coverage.peer_rank@FY2024}}), FFO to debt ({{ffo_to_debt.peer_rank@FY2024}}) and FCF to debt ({{fcf_to_debt.peer_rank@FY2024}}).
Leverage sits in the middle of the group, with net leverage ranking {{net_leverage.peer_rank@FY2024}} and gross leverage {{gross_leverage.peer_rank@FY2024}}.

Cash liquidity to revenue is the weakest of the group ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@FY2024}}), at {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}} against a median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2024}}.

watch_items.text: Liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, below the peer median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2024}}.
Coverage: interest coverage eased by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2024}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2024}} as finance costs rose by {{finance_costs.change@FY2024}} to {{finance_costs@FY2024}}.
Traffic: growth slowed by {{traffic_growth.change@FY2024}} to {{traffic_growth@FY2024}}, and the CNMC left the maximum adjusted annual revenue per passenger for 2025 unchanged versus the prior year.
